body:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Production sprite atlas correction. Preserve the provided Ichigo Shikai atlas's 32 CHARACTERS exactly: same hair, faces, robe, white sash, feet, hard-edged pixel art, directions, poses and 8-column by 4-row grid. IMPORTANT EDIT: REMOVE EVERY SWORD, HANDLE AND TRAILING BANDAGE from ALL 32 character sprites, leaving only clean transparent background where the weapons were. The game will attach a separate rigid weapon, so the character bodies must NOT contain any blade, hilt, weapon scrap or white bandage hanging outside the hands. Carefully restore clothing contours hidden by swords. Keep hands as empty GRIPPING FISTS, positioned to receive a weapon. In column8 the two fists brace an invisible hilt at waist/chest height, knees bent as guarding. In column6 right gripping hand at the shoulder, column7 right fist extended in attack follow-through. Column1-5 keep empty gripping right hand near shoulder, no weapon. Maintain original 8x4 equal grid with every complete body in its own cell. Transparent alpha and generous margins.
EXTEND THE SHEET DOWNWARD by one additional row of the same height (total 5 rows). The first FOUR rows remain the same 32 body-only sprites. In the FIFTH bottom row draw just ONE SEPARATE RIGID ZANGETSU WEAPON SPRITE horizontally centered across that row: handle at the LEFT, blade tip at the RIGHT. Full weapon visible in strict flat SIDE VIEW with NO perspective. Perfectly horizontal straight centerline y, straight cylindrical white-wrapped short hilt, no guard, broad black single-edged cleaver blade with straight spine, straight silver cutting edge, tapered diagonal tip ONLY at the very right end. Handle's centerline must exactly match blade's long centerline, no bend, no kink, no offset, no hook, no cloth tail. Grip should be about 20% of total weapon length. Blade width about 13% of its full weapon length, broad cleaver like the character's sword. Draw it in the same clean pixel-art style and palette as the character. Leave all other fifth-row space transparent. This bottom-row sword will be cropped as one rigid texture and rotated as a unit, do not attach it to any character. No labels, no grids, no effects, no checkerboard.
guard:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this 4x4 Ichigo Shikai defense sprite sheet for a game. Keep ALL SIXTEEN BODY SPRITES exactly in their existing positions, row directions, proportions and animation poses. Preserve heads, faces, orange hair, black shihakusho, white robe collar and white waist sash, legs, sandals, outlines and pixel-art palette unchanged.
REMOVE ALL WEAPONS FROM EVERY SPRITE: erase all black sword blades, silver edges, white-wrapped sword handles and trailing bandage strips, replacing their entire pixels with genuinely transparent alpha. There must be ZERO weapon pixels in this sheet. Restore the clothing hidden by the swords without changing silhouette. Keep the hands in their present gripping-fist poses so an external rigid weapon can be attached in the game; do not redraw hands into relaxed palms. Row1 front/down, row2 left, row3 back/up, row4 right, four consecutive guarding body poses per row. Keep original transparent background. No labels, effects, grids, shadows or additional objects. Do not create a separate sword anywhere. This is only a body animation layer, exact original 4 columns and 4 rows, every complete body contained within its original cell with transparent margins.
zangetsu:
Use case: precise-object-edit, game weapon asset. Extract and redraw ONLY the large Zangetsu Shikai sword shown in the main central reference screenshot, removing ALL browser UI, text, photograph margins, checkerboard and background. Output exactly ONE standalone sword on genuine transparent alpha, horizontal orientation with HILT ON THE LEFT and POINT ON THE RIGHT, 1024x512 landscape canvas with the sword in the central horizontal band and generous transparent margin. The reference is the authority for shape: long narrow straight white/gray bandage-wrapped hilt; no crossguard; small concave notch at blade root; very broad matte-black cleaver blade; wide steel-gray/silver sharpened edge sweeping gradually toward an extremely long pointed tip. Keep the reference's distinctive broad silhouette and curved cutting-edge contour, NOT a katana, NOT a rectangular machete and NOT a symmetrically double-edged sword.
CRITICAL GEOMETRY: the straight handle and long axis of the blade must lie on one continuous straight horizontal line. The blade can widen on its cutting-edge side but must never kink or bend at the neck. No crooked or offset handle. The grip is rigid, no hook shape. The narrow white fabric strip at the end of the hilt is a distinct soft ribbon and may curve downward slightly, but the rigid hilt must remain visibly straight. Keep the ribbon short so it cannot be mistaken for a bent handle. Handle length about one quarter of total rigid weapon length, blade maximum width about 12% of total length. Match the reference closely.
Style: crisp clean pixel art for a polished chibi anime RPG, dark outline and flat black/gray/white clusters, limited palette and no antialiased blurry edges. Fully visible single sword, no body or hands, no sparkles, no effects, no shadows, no labels, no watermark. Side-on orthographic silhouette with no perspective shortening. This texture will be attached to character fists and rotated rigidly as a unit.
